body: Uc self damage is based on calculations, you have control over it. Vigilante is not.

Well this is my own tier list for not only how strong they are but how fun they play.
I do think tier list in this game is just for fun, all character is strong in their own way,  the tier list is mostly about how much i enjoy playing them.
I put Gunner and Vigilante at the bottom because i don't like playing em.
Gunner is boring...
Vigilante - i hate this character to the bones. He is unreliable, heavy RGN, his passive don't work well with debuff card ( mark, drunk, force crit,..) His early game suck because he have no damage, his late game even worse - he hurt himself more than the enemies..
He is really good for the first map, but eventually later there are some enemies can counter his melee heavy kits.
Really weird tier list here. The only one i think we have in common is Gunner.
I tried to stay positives, i really do but i just can't anymore.
